title: UAP Disclosure Act controlled disclosure campaign plan and records review board
summary: Matthew Pines tells of UAP Disclosure Act controlled disclosure campaign plan and records review board, about 2023-2024 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: control disclosure campaign plan would set up this UAP records review board and that records review board would be have all the status of an ex uh executive department agency obviously the subpoena authority the uni lateral declassification authority with presidential override

plain: A researcher named Matthew Pines describes the UAP Disclosure Act, a bill put before the US Congress in 2023 and 2024 about releasing government records on UAP, meaning unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs. He says its plan for a controlled release of information, which he links to a man named Karl Nell, would create a UAP records review board with the standing of a government agency, the power to force testimony and records, and the power to declassify secrets on its own, with the president able to overrule it. Pines tells it to show how seriously the bill's authors took the idea of hidden records.
